prompt:
No shadows. Pixel-art sprite sheet in exactly the style and palette of the attached image. Crisp hard pixels on a strict grid, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, each sprite with a dark 1-pixel outline, drawn at its final size with no finer detail than that size can hold. One three-quarter top-down projection, never isometric. Sprites in a neat grid with even spacing on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background, nothing touching, no ground under them, no text unless asked. Bright yellow and bright red appear nowhere.

Two track tiles drawn on EXACTLY the gauge of the attached sheet c2's straight pieces: the two rails 32 art px apart, centred on the tile, running all the way to the tile's edges, the ties spaced as on c2's straights. The last try came with the rails 44 px apart: that is wrong. 1. a curve joining the top side and the left side (north–west); 2. a T-junction with exits north, east and south (a straight from top to bottom with a branch curving off to the right). Each tile the same square size as c2's, magenta round each, apart.

Flat from above, exactly like the attached track sheet c2: dark iron rails on honey-wood ties, the ties evenly spaced.

No frames, no boxes, no grid lines, no borders between sprites; each sprite floats alone on the magenta.

No shadows, no smoke, no glow.

Keep exactly the colours of the attached frame F1: the grass as saturated and bright as in it (about #7cbd40), the paths warm sand (about #e4b469); warm honey wood, light cool stone, teal and plum cloth, cream bone.

No yellow, no orange and no red anywhere: those colours are reserved for the product's signals. The wood a muted honey brown, never orange.

Output the sheet as a PNG image.

Attached, in order: f1-town, c2-track. F1 is the approved frame: its style and colours rule.
